title: Expressions for Waves
description: Essential Criteria: Provide correct expressions for the right and left circularly polarized plane waves.

title: Rotation Angle Derivation
description: Important Criteria: Derive the angle of rotation of the plane of polarization as a function of distance into the medium.

title: High Frequency Definition
description: Important Criteria: Clearly specify what is meant by high frequencies in the context of the problem.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect assumptions about the indices of refraction.
